design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 0 (workflow task cd_wf_post_grace_renewal_and_add_on). Frozen 2026-09-14 09:40:00 EDT.
[Why a good test] The customer asks for one thing only - move as much money as her bump-up CD will take from her money market. Answering it correctly forces a four-problem tree hidden behind policy: the certificate's grace period ended on 2026-09-13 (maturity 2026-09-03 + grace_period_days 10), so a term add-on needs an active new term (renewal owed today); the renewal can be booked only under auto_renew but the record carries pay_out_to_savings to a Statement Savings closed on 2026-06-18; and the renewal rate's jumbo bonus is judged on the ledger principal, which is 99951.82 until the owed reversal of a 2026-01-20 penalty booked at 3.43 instead of the term's charter rate 3.58 lifts it to 100292.24. Difficulty comes from reading policy, reconciling the ledger (deposits + compounded interest + reversals - withdrawals - penalties, excluding 15 interest payouts totalling 4702.55), branching on tier/instruction/status, and reading checking and savings holdings - not from guessing tools (each problem has exactly one tool).
[Scope snapshot] Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0). Claimed here: extended policies cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal, cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction, cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate, cd_ext_term_add_on_amount; the single workflow cd_wf_post_grace_renewal_and_add_on; tools reverse_penalty_error_2ccc5de3, update_maturity_instruction_96ab509d, renew_certificate_term_21cb639a, add_term_deposit_5f936ecf. Left for task 1 (non-workflow): the grace-period side of the product - interest disposition changes, penalties on grace withdrawals and grace add-ons (cd_update_instructions via a disposition tool, cd_penalty_reversal of the grace-withdrawal class, cd_deposit of kind grace_add_on) - an independent tree on a certificate still inside its grace window. The gate-level design constraint recorded at difficulty pre-check: the blueprint's owner_confirms gate on cd_withdrawal is mixed-authority with a single correlation field, which a single evidence binding can never satisfy as both system and caller, so no gold write in this difficulty realises cd_withdrawal (nor the cd_penalty/cd_close writes that follow a withdrawal).
[Problem-tree card] Root cd_ext_term_add_on_amount (add_term_deposit_5f936ecf, owner user). Edge 1 root -> cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate, value_input, gate binding 'active'; condition 'The certificate whose grace period has ended stands in an active new term when the add-on is measured.'; policy_source 'A term add-on is made on an active certificate, so a certificate still in grace period status whose renewal is due has that renewal booked first; ...'; false at opening: cd_certificates.status = grace_period, term_start_date = 2025-03-03. Edge 2 renewal -> cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal, value_input, gate 'reversals'; policy_source 'Every penalty reversal owed on the certificate is posted before the renewal is booked, because the jumbo bonus is judged on the reconciled principal as it stands when the renewal is booked.'; false at opening: penalty rate_applied 3.43, no cd_penalty_reversal entry, principal 99951.82. Edge 3 renewal -> cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction, state_gate, gate cd_certificates.renewal_instruction; policy_source 'A certificate renews only under an instruction to renew automatically, so a payout instruction that must be replaced is replaced before the renewal is booked.'; false at opening: renewal_instruction pay_out_to_savings, payout Statement Savings status closed. Topological order: reversal, instruction, renewal, add-on (the first two are parallel). Deletion sensitivity (sens.py run): skip reversal -> renewal 3.98 instead of 4.08; skip instruction -> renewal 0 (none written) instead of 4.08; skip renewal -> add-on 0 instead of 21406.18; skip add-on -> terminal lacks the deposit. Swapping reversal and instruction: identical values and terminal DB ('swapped-order terminal equal to gold order: True'). user_scenario never names a penalty, reversal, instruction, grace period or renewal; tools check none of these (the skip runs wrote normally).
[Base-invariant card] cd_penalty_reversal: cd_evt_penalty_reversal.reverse_once ('A penalty can be reversed at most once.') - evidence: the one cd_penalty row, no reversal row. cd_update_instructions: cd_instructions.payout_account_owned - the new payout account is the active Premier Money Market of the same customer. cd_renew: cd_rate_and_bonuses and cd_evt_maturity_and_grace have no gate for cd_renew (policy_scope); the renewal timing is the base rule 'On the day after the grace period ends ...' - grace counted from the day after maturity_date as day 1, allowed through maturity_date + grace_period_days (2026-09-13 inclusive); 2026-09-14 is the first day after, so the renewal is due (positive case 2026-09-14, negative case 2026-09-13 still in grace). cd_deposit: concentration_cap (100292.24 + 21406.18 far below 2500000.00), cd_open_and_funding policy_scope (deposit from the same customer's money market), grace_window (after renewal the maturity_date is 2028-03-03; limit 2028-03-13 inclusive), active_for_add_on (status active set by the renewal at step 11).
[Business-object card] Target object: certificate ending 5231 (one certificate). Penalty object: the single cd_penalty row (source_item_id = the 20125.00 early_partial withdrawal of 2026-01-20); the reversal writes source_item_id = that penalty row. Principal reconciliation includes 2 deposits (96500.00 opening, 23000.00 term add-on), 4 compounded interest rows (291.82, 302.45, 303.37, 19.60 = 917.24), the withdrawal 20125.00, the penalty 340.42 and (after step 7) the reversal 340.42; it excludes 15 cd_interest_payout rows (2025-03 to 2026-05, 4702.55) paid to the Statement Savings while it was open. Add-on funding: the only active savings account (Premier Money Market ending 4417, 21406.18); the closed Statement Savings ending 4583 is excluded by status.
[Seed rows and their load] customers (Nadia Okafor; credentials 3365550147 / 1968-04-22 / 4718 in band); checking Premier Checking ending 5092 opened 2016-03-01 (removing it drops the relationship bonus everywhere: the charter rate becomes 3.43, equal to the booked rate, so no reversal is owed; the renewal then sees principal 99951.82 (no jumbo) and no relationship bonus, 3.83 + 0 + 0 = 3.83 instead of 4.08); savings Premier Money Market ending 4417 active 21406.18 (removing it makes the add-on 0 and leaves no active payout account); savings Statement Savings ending 4583 closed 2026-06-18 (if it were active the instruction would not be replaced and no renewal would be due); certificate (grace_period, instruction pay_out_to_savings on the closed Statement Savings, interest_disposition compound - she switched her interest to compound when she closed the Statement Savings on 2026-06-18, so the fifteen earlier interest payouts went to that account while it was open and June onwards compounded - rate 3.58, relationship true, jumbo false); ledger 23 rows. Automatic clauses checked: interest from June 2026 compounds under the compound disposition (and base cd_evt_interest would compound it anyway once the payout account closed), which the June-September compound rows reflect; the maturity credit posted on 2026-09-03; no lapse, no bump (bump_up_used false is irrelevant because the renewal resets it); no unsettled row ignites an obligation outside this task: evaluated on the opening world, cd_ext_interest_payout_repoint writes nothing (the disposition is compound, and a payout maturity instruction on the closed account is outside it anyway), cd_ext_grace_withdrawal_penalty_reversal gives 0 (the penalty is not on a grace-period withdrawal) and cd_ext_grace_jumbo_top_up gives 0 (grace ended on 2026-09-13). No cache field is used as a trap; principal_balance equals the ledger.
[Persona design] Retired librarian, unhurried and friendly. Volunteered: only the surface goal and that she will do the transfer herself. Given on request: phone, DOB, SSN last four, certificate ending 5231, money market ending 4417, 'most the CD will accept'. Passive: the Statement Savings closure only if the agent brings it up; the money market as the account that receives the CD's money when it is paid out, only if asked; if asked about interest, that it keeps being added to the CD as it has since June (matching interest_disposition compound); 'keep it going, same kind of bump-up CD' only if asked; accepts a quoted rate; runs the handed-over deposit with the amount the agent gives and reads back the receipt; ends when told the money was added (her last reaction answers the last gold action). She states no balance, rate or penalty and never corrects the agent.
[Reachability] Every must-ask item has an answer: identity (3 credentials), target CD (5231), funding account (4417), amount ('as much as it will take'), payout account for the replacement instruction (4417, as the account that receives the CD's money), interest handling (keep compounding - no disposition change), renewal wish (yes). The owner=user add-on is unlocked by the agent and run by the customer in the same turn; its receipt enters the shared transcript. All four writes are synchronous bookings at one frozen_time; nothing depends on an external event.
[Zero-wait causal card] Step 0 reversal: prerequisites = cd_penalty row and certificate record (initial_state_preexisting). Step 1 instruction: certificate instruction, closed Statement Savings, active money market (initial_state_preexisting) + payout account named by the customer (current_user_input). Step 2 renewal: auto_renew recorded by step 1 and principal raised by step 0 (prior_synchronous_tool_effect), maturity_date 2026-09-03 and status (initial_state_preexisting). Step 3 add-on: status active and term_start_date 2026-09-03 written by step 2 (prior_synchronous_tool_effect), money market balance (initial_state_preexisting), the customer's instruction to move 'as much as it will take' (current_user_input). No status label stands in for a real-world event.
[Standard solution] find_customers(3365550147) -> verify (phone, DOB, SSN) -> find_cd_certificates -> find_cd_transactions -> find_checking_accounts -> find_savings_accounts -> unlock/call reverse_penalty_error (source_item_id = penalty row, 340.42) -> unlock/call update_maturity_instruction (auto_renew, payout = money market) -> unlock/call renew_certificate_term (18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, 2026-09-03, 2028-03-03, 4.08, 4.15, true, true) -> unlock_user/call_user add_term_deposit (21406.18, pcb_savings, money market).
[Verification run] Commands: python3 seed0.py seed0.json (W 20125, pen 340.42, principal 99951.82, after reversal 100292.24); check_compute --task 0 -> COMPUTE OK (4 comps, 47 factors, 12 history rows, 23 branches); sens.py 0 -> gold {340.42, auto_renew, 4.08, 21406.18}; skip-step values as listed in the problem-tree card. The key computation cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate has 16 bindings, the untriggered branch 'not (due and auto and same_tier)' and cross/history load: forcing CFIELD off gives 3.93, zeroing the ledger sums gives 3.98.
[Easy mistakes] (1) Adding the 15 interest payouts to principal (before the reversal 99951.82 + 4702.55 = 104654.37 - jumbo true even without the reversal, hiding the reversal's effect); (2) using F interest_rate 3.58 without checking the relationship and concluding nothing is wrong - the rule's rebuild confirms 3.58 is the charter rate and 3.43 is not; (3) reversing only the 14.88 difference (base: never in part); (4) booking a grace add-on on 2026-09-14 (grace ended 2026-09-13 inclusive); (5) renewing before the reversal (rate 3.98) or before the instruction fix; (6) counting the 2025-08-15 add-on against the new term (it predates term_start 2026-09-03), which would exhaust the one add-on allowed per term and allow nothing; (7) paying out to the closed Statement Savings.
[Rule/compute two-way sweep] For each policy compute_basis quotes the rule sentence for every world-reading binding (see cd.extended.yaml); reverse sweep: reversal rule's 'most recent cd_penalty entry' (amount, rate, days and date all from that one entry), grace-penalty carve-out, rebuild of standard rate, relationship test with opened_date and closed_date (a bonus earned at term start stays), seven-day minimum, 0.001 tolerance, 'never in part', 'not reversed again' each map to a binding; instruction rule's closed-status test per account kind, auto_renew_available, 'left as they are' map to bindings; renewal rule's due test (day after maturity counted as day 1, > grace_period_days), auto_renew, same-tier scope, five ledger sums, jumbo test, relationship test, single final rounding map to bindings; add-on rule's active/funded/offered tests, latest add-on on or after term_start, three rooms, smallest-of, min amount map to bindings. Overwrites: cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction declares the replaced payout sentence of cd_evt_maturity_and_grace; cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal declares that it checks a penalty against the rate the charter fixes for the term instead of the interest_rate factor of cd_evt_early_withdrawal (the two agree whenever the certificate record is consistent, as here); the remaining task-0 policies evaluate to the same quantities as base and declare [].
[Visible-context draft] Without compute/GT: the KB says a term add-on needs an active certificate (grace over, renewal owed), renewal only under auto_renew (instruction names a closed account -> replace), jumbo judged on reconciled principal after owed reversals (penalty at 3.43 vs charter 3.58 -> reverse 340.42). From the reads: principal 100292.24 -> 4.08/4.15; add-on = min(25000, 899707.76, 21406.18) = 21406.18. Same as gold.
[Revisions] (a) check_compute raised 'disallowed syntax List' for pays_out -> rewrote as two equality tests -> COMPUTE OK. (b) replay closure mismatch (an unread completed cd_requests row) -> dropped the row -> REPLAY OK. (c) check_extended counted the helper _cd_ledger_row as an undiscoverable tool -> replaced by module constant LEDGER_DEFAULTS -> EXTENDED OK. (d) factor trace first stated compounded 1057.24; recomputed 917.24 from the seed and corrected. Per-task gates run: EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK, GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK, CACHE-DIFF INFO.

[Revisions round 2 - policy-task audit] T0-1/G4: the seed had interest_disposition pay_to_savings on the same closed Statement Savings, so cd_ext_interest_payout_repoint (task 1's policy) was also due and, recorded first, would have made the payout instruction look valid and blocked the renewal. Changes: the seed now carries interest_disposition compound (she switched to compound when she closed the account on 2026-06-18; the payout rows stop in May and compounding starts in June); the charter pins the order - cd_ext_interest_payout_repoint excludes a certificate whose maturity instruction pays out to the same closed account, and cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction says its recorded payout account also receives the interest. Re-run: every non-scope policy evaluates to no write on the opening world (sens.py: repoint returns the payout account unchanged, grace reversal 0, grace top-up 0). T0-2: the seed-load sentence said 'renewal 3.93'; with the checking row removed no reversal is owed and the renewal is 3.83 - corrected. G1: cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal now dedups per penalty (COUNT of reversals whose source_item_id is the penalty). G2: the charter rate keeps a relationship bonus earned at term start even if the checking account closes later (opened on or before term_start and not closed before it), and the use of that rate instead of the recorded interest_rate is declared in overwrite against cd_evt_early_withdrawal. O2: amount, rate, days and date now all come from the one most recent penalty entry. O14: a penalty on a grace-period withdrawal is carved out of this policy. O5: cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction gained the binding not_late (DAYS(maturity, frozen) <= grace_period_days + 1; here 11 <= 11). O9: the renew tool's maturity_date is described as the new term's maturity date. Values unchanged: 340.42, auto_renew, 4.08, 21406.18; skip runs 3.98 / 0 / 0 as before; swapped P1/P2 order terminal equal.
[Revisions round 3 - policy-task audit r2] R2-T0-1: after the round-2 seed change (interest_disposition compound) the persona still answered 'where the CD's interest or its money should go' with the money market, which a faithful agent could record as a pay_to_savings disposition change. The persona now names the money market only as the account that receives the CD's money when it is paid out, and says the interest should keep being added to the CD as it has since June - the same fact the seed carries (compound rows from 2026-06-30, disposition compound). required_user_inputs and the payout_account_id tracing were updated with the new verbatim lines. Persona/seed consistency re-checked line by line: Greensboro address, CD ending 5231 (only certificate), money market ending 4417 (only open savings, 21406.18), Statement Savings closed 2026-06-18, penalty from January 2026, compounding since June, credentials 3365550147 / 1968-04-22 / 4718 - all match initial_state. Charter observations: R2-O1 the penalty_rate_basis reading is now stated in the rule and the P1 overwrite; R2-O2/O1 P1 checks the owner's active and closed checking accounts separately (one qualifying account is enough) instead of the first row of any status; R2-O5 P1 and P5 state that an earlier penalty falls to cd_evt_penalty_reversal. Values unchanged (340.42, auto_renew, 4.08, 21406.18).
[Revisions round 4 - policy-KB audit] D3: cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction now also names, in overwrite, the cd_instructions clause 'a change recorded after that governs the next maturity' and states in its rule that an owner's change after grace governs the next maturity while this bank-owed replacement, recorded at the latest on the day after grace, governs the maturity just passed (task 0 records it on day 11). D4: cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate declares in overwrite that the jumbo test uses the ledger-reconciled principal instead of base's recorded principal_balance on the renewal date, and says the reconciled figure governs where the two differ (here both are 99951.82 before and 100292.24 after the reversal). D2 source: the renewal prerequisite's condition and policy_source now read 'an instruction to renew automatically' instead of the enum token, and the add-on prerequisite's policy_source reads 'grace period status'; the prerequisite_closure copies and the quotes above were updated. No binding changed; values 340.42 / auto_renew / 4.08 / 21406.18 unchanged. Persona/seed re-checked: no persona line touched.
[Revisions round 5 - policy-KB re-audit] S2: cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction now retires the whole cd_instructions timing sentence ('A change to the renewal instruction must be recorded before the grace period ends to govern this maturity; a change recorded after that governs the next maturity.') and restates it in full with the single exception: owner changes before grace ends govern this maturity, owner changes after it govern the next, and this bank-owed replacement recorded at the latest on the day after grace governs the maturity just passed (task 0: day 11). S3: the cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate replacement for the retired renewal-principal clause now states that the reconciled principal is the renewal-date principal for the jumbo test of every renewal, including a renewal into a different tier chosen during grace and one booked during grace, so the retirement leaves no renewal ungoverned. S1: the same rule ties the base 'target tier' to fields - the tier the certificate renews into, i.e. renewal_target_tier without a grace term change, otherwise the tier chosen during grace. No binding, value, persona line or seed field changed; prerequisite quotations re-verified verbatim against the rules and the prerequisite_closure copies.
[Revisions round 6 - policy-task audit r5] R5-G1: the round-2 recording deadline of cd_ext_closed_payout_instruction (binding not_late, 'at the latest on the day after the grace period ends') is removed, superseding the round-2 and round-4/5 notes above that mention it. The replacement is now owed while the certificate is active or in its grace period and is recorded before the grace outcome is booked, however many days have passed (binding outcome_open), so a closed-account payout instruction whose grace outcome is still unbooked on day 12 or later is still replaced and the certificate then renews under cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate (probe on this seed: day 11, day 12 and day 47 all give auto_renew, then a renewal rate of 3.98 before the reversal and 4.08 after it). Where a tier offered no automatic renewal the instruction would be replaced by mail_check (official check), so the retired payout clause's whole domain has an outcome. The cd_instructions exception now reads 'recorded before the outcome of the grace period is booked'. O2b: cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal now checks only a penalty taken in the current term (posted_date on or after term_start_date, binding in_current_term) because it rebuilds the current term's rate; an earlier-term penalty is left to cd_evt_penalty_reversal. Here the penalty (2026-01-20) is in the current term (from 2025-03-03). R5-O1: the P1 replacement now restates the whole factor ('the penalty basis times this rate divided by 100 times penalty_days divided by day_count_basis'). Values unchanged: 340.42 / auto_renew / 4.08 / 21406.18; skip runs 3.98 / 0 / 0. No persona line or seed field changed; prerequisite quotations re-verified verbatim.
[Revisions round 7 - policy-KB audit source-layer item SL-3] Symptom: for a renewal booked after the grace period has ended, 'renewal date' in cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate could be read as the old maturity date (the new term's start) or as the booking day; the rule tested the relationship bonus 'on the renewal date' while the compute read the checking account that is active at booking, and the jumbo principal 'on the renewal date' was a whole-ledger sum that includes a reversal posted on the booking day. The readings coincide in this world (Premier Checking active since 2016-03-01) but diverge where a qualifying checking account opens or closes between the maturity date and a late booking. Root cause: the source never fixed which day 'renewal date' names, and the booking-day reading also contradicts the rest of the charter - the certificate record keeps no booking date, so cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal rebuilds a term's relationship bonus from the account held on term_start_date; base cd_rate_and_bonuses fixes 'The rate of a term ... at its start', equates 'principal at term start' with 'the principal_balance on the renewal date after any grace-period add-ons and withdrawals', keeps a bonus lost mid-term and defers one gained mid-term, and cd_evt_interest has renewing balance earn 'the new term's rate from the maturity date'. Change (cd.extended.yaml, cd_ext_post_grace_renewal_rate only; base untouched): (1) the rule now defines 'The renewal date of every renewal is the first day of its new term, which is the old maturity_date, whether the renewal is booked by the owner during grace, on the day after the grace period ends or on any later day; it is never the day on which the renewal is booked.' (2) The relationship bonus of a renewed term is earned when the owner held on the renewal date a qualifying checking account opened on or before it and not closed on or before it, over the owner's active and closed checking accounts; one opened after the renewal date does not earn it, one closed after it still does even if closed before the booking. New bindings renewal_date = F maturity_date, checking_opened, closed_tier, closed_opened, checking_closed; relationship now tests those dates (cross_category reads gain opened_date and closed_date). (3) The jumbo input is renamed 'the renewal principal' and pinned to the ledger 'as it stands when the renewal is booked', which 'takes in every grace-period add-on and withdrawal and every penalty reversal posted before the renewal is booked, although the new term is dated from the old maturity_date'; the overwrite replaced_by for the retired cd_rate_and_bonuses clause, the jumbo/principal compute_basis quotes, the P1-edge policy_source ('... because the jumbo bonus is judged on the reconciled principal as it stands when the renewal is booked.') and effect, and the workflow order_rationale phrase were updated to match; the prerequisite_closure edge copy, the problem-tree card quote above, the renewal tracing (term_start_date, interest_rate, jumbo_bonus_applied, relationship_bonus_applied), the factor trace and the read-node necessities were propagated. (4) Same-test alignment: cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal's 'not closed before it' became 'not closed on or before it', which is what its compute (checking_closed > term_start_date) already did; no binding changed there. The renew tool's contract already names term_start_date 'first day of the new term' and states no bonus test, so it needed no change. Probe (scratch probe on this seed, after steps 7 and 9): gold world relationship true, rate 4.08; checking closed 2026-09-10 -> true, 4.08 (booking-day reading would give 3.93, and a later new-term penalty booked at 3.93 would then be reversed by cd_ext_penalty_rate_reversal whose rebuild gives 4.08 - the inconsistency the fix removes); closed 2026-09-03 -> false, 3.93; active but opened 2026-09-08 -> false, 3.93 (booking-day reading 4.08, again contradicted by the later rebuild at 3.93); frozen 2026-09-13 not due, 2026-09-14 / 09-21 / 10-20 due with renewal_date 2026-09-03 and 4.08; skipping the reversal still gives 3.98. Values unchanged: 340.42 / auto_renew / 18-Month Bump-Up Certificate, 2026-09-03, 2028-03-03, 4.08, 4.15, true, true / 21406.18; order, owners, terminal state and skip runs (3.98 / 0 / 0) unchanged; no persona line or seed field changed. Easy mistake added: testing the relationship bonus on the booking day 2026-09-14 instead of the renewal date 2026-09-03 (same answer here, wrong wherever a checking account opened or closed in between). Gates re-run (--task 0): EXTENDED OK, TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK, REPLAY OK, SOLVABILITY OK, COMPUTE OK (4 comps, 59 factors, 12 history rows, 31 branches), GROUNDING OK, SCOPE OK.
user_scenario:
You are Nadia Okafor, a retired Guilford County school librarian in Greensboro who likes to get things done in one phone call and speaks in a friendly, unhurried way. You open by saying you have a bump-up CD with Piedmont Crescent and you would like to move as much money into it from your money market account as it will take, even if that is everything in the money market. That is the only thing you called about. You are happy for the agent to take care of whatever the bank has to do on its side, and you will make the transfer out of your money market yourself once the agent sets it up and tells you the amount; you do not want anything else changed on your own initiative.
You give your details only when the agent asks for them, one or two at a time: your mobile number is 3365550147, your date of birth is 1968-04-22, and the last four of your Social Security number are 4718. If the agent asks which CD, it is the bump-up certificate whose number ends in 5231; if asked which money market, it ends in 4417 and it is the only savings account you still have open. If the agent asks how much, you say you do not know the limits and want the most the CD will accept, up to all of the money market. You do not know the balance of either account by heart and ask the agent to read it from the records.
Only if the agent brings up your old Statement Savings account do you mention that you closed it in June. Only if the agent asks which account should receive the CD's money whenever it is paid out do you say the money market ending in 4417. If the agent asks about the CD's interest, you say you want it to keep being added to the CD, the way it has been since June, and not sent anywhere else. Only if the agent asks whether you want to keep the CD going for another term do you say yes, the same kind of bump-up CD; if the agent asks whether you would rather have it paid out, you say no. If the agent tells you a penalty from earlier this year is being credited back, you say that is a nice surprise and thank them. If the agent tells you the certificate has been renewed or quotes you a new rate, you accept it without negotiating.
When the agent hands the deposit step over to you, you carry it out with exactly the amount, the certificate and the money market account the agent tells you, and then read back to the agent what the confirmation says. Once you hear the money has been added to the CD, you thank the agent and end the call. If the agent says the CD cannot take any money, you say that is disappointing, thank them and end the call.

gold_actions.business_effect: Posts a 340.42 cd_penalty_reversal (bank_error) against the 2026-01-20 penalty and raises principal to 100292.24.

request_binding.action_semantics: A penalty booked at a rate other than the charter's is a state_due bank error the bank must reverse whatever the customer called about; among the penalty-related actions only a full reversal applies, never a partial one or a courtesy waiver.

discriminator.business_meaning: penalty booked at rate 3.43 while the term's charter rate is 3.58

stage_provenance.fact: The reversal of the misassessed penalty is booked by this call.

gold_actions.zero_wait_proof: Workflow step 0: every prerequisite is either an authoritative initial_state record or the synchronous DB effect of an earlier gold call in this consultation (the cd_penalty entry and certificate record in initial_state); nothing waits for a delivery, a clearing, a review or the passage of time, and the whole chain runs at frozen_time 2026-09-14 09:40:00 EDT.

base_preconditions.condition: A penalty can be reversed at most once.

gold_actions.business_effect: Replaces pay_out_to_savings (closed Statement Savings) with auto_renew and records the active money market ending 4417 as payout account.

request_binding.action_semantics: A payout instruction naming a closed payout account cannot be carried out when grace ends; the state_due fix is an instruction change on the certificate, not a payout, an official check or a closure.

edges.condition: The certificate whose grace period has ended stands in an active new term when the add-on is measured.
edges.policy_source: A term add-on is made on an active certificate, so a certificate still in grace period status whose renewal is due has that renewal booked first; the renewal starts a new term, and an add-on of the previous term no longer counts.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two parallel prerequisites of the renewal (the penalty reversal and the instruction replacement) write disjoint data: the reversal writes a ledger entry and principal_balance, the instruction change writes renewal_instruction and payout_account_id. Replaying the gold with the two swapped (actions 8-9 before 6-7) gives the same computed values (340.42, auto_renew, 4.08, 21406.18) and an identical terminal DB (sens.py run: 'swapped-order terminal equal to gold order: True'). The chain renewal -> add-on is fixed by cd_evt_term_add_on 'A term add-on is allowed only while the certificate's status is active.'

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Skipping the renewal (step 11) leaves status grace_period: the add-on amount recomputes to 0 instead of 21406.18, and the terminal certificate keeps the old term, rate 3.58 and status grace_period.
Skipping the reversal (step 7) leaves principal 99951.82 < 100000.00: the renewal rate recomputes to 3.98 instead of 4.08 (no jumbo), and the terminal ledger lacks the 340.42 reversal.

Skipping the instruction replacement (step 9) leaves pay_out_to_savings: the renewal recomputes to 0 (no renewal is written) instead of 4.08, and the terminal certificate keeps the closed payout account.
